description: SecretBundle.value and DeletedSecretBundle.value carry the secret's plain value (GetSecret, SetSecret, UpdateSecret, RecoverDeletedSecret, RestoreSecret, DeleteSecret, GetDeletedSecret), and SetSecret's input `value` is the secret itself, but the spec has no sensitive mark, so callers receive and pass a plain string. Mark all three sensitive: outputs decode as Redacted, and the input accepts Redacted.
